translationRepairs: In the fourth month of Zhide 3 she was enfeoffed as empress. The text read: "Qian is heaven and Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang and the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.

In the fourth month of Zhida 3 she was enfeoffed as empress. The text read: "Qian is heaven and Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang and the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
s0099 has 至大三年四月; 至大 is the Yuan era Zhida, not Zhide, so the proposed idiomatic correctly restores the reign title.

In the fourth month of the third year of Zhide she was enfeoffed as empress; the text read: "Qian is heaven, Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang, the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.

In the fourth month of the third year of Zhida she was enfeoffed as empress; the text read: "Qian is heaven, Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang, the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
The same Chinese 至大三年四月 shows literal Zhide is wrong; Zhida matches 至大.
Empress Sugabala was the daughter of Ochen Harqishi and a cousin of Empress Zhenge on her mother's side.
Empress Sugabala was the daughter of Ochen Harqishi and a cousin of Empress Zhenge.
s0108 has 真哥皇后之從妹也; 從妹 is a younger female cousin and does not mark a maternal-line relation, so removing on her mother's side is required.
Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, a niece by marriage of Chengzong.
Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, a niece of Chengzong.
s0154 has 成宗甥壽寧公主; 甥 is a sibling's child, not a niece by marriage, so niece of Chengzong is the accurate repair.
Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, Chengzong's niece by marriage.
Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, Chengzong's niece.
The same 成宗甥 shows literal niece by marriage invents affinity; Chengzong's niece restores the kinship term.
She died in the eighth month of Zhiping 25, aged forty-two.
She died in the eighth month of Zhizheng 25, aged forty-two.
s0225 has 至正二十五年八月; 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
She died in the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhiping, aged forty-two.
She died in the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhizheng, aged forty-two.
The same Chinese 至正二十五年八月 confirms literal must read Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
After more than a month the crown prince returned from Jining and wept for her with great grief.
After more than a month the crown prince returned from Ji'ning and wept for her with great grief.
s0228 has 自冀寧歸; 冀寧 is distinct from 濟寧, and Ji'ning correctly blocks conflation with Jining.
After more than a month the crown prince returned from Jining and wept for her with great grief.
After more than a month the crown prince returned from Ji'ning and wept for her with great grief.
The same 冀寧 shows literal Jining collapses two different place-names; Ji'ning is the needed disambiguation.
At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Xuanhui Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Emperor Shun.
At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Huizheng Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Emperor Shun.
s0231 has 徽政院使; 徽政院 is the Huizheng Court, not 宣徽院 Xuanhui Court.
At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Xuanhui Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Shundi.
At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Huizheng Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Shundi.
The same 徽政院使 shows literal Xuanhui Court is a wrong office name; Huizheng Court matches the Chinese.

When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Xuanhui Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.

When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Huizheng Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.
s0235 has 改徽政院為資正院; the renamed body is the Huizheng Court, not the Xuanhui Court.

When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Xuanhui Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.

When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Huizheng Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.
The same 改徽政院為資正院 confirms literal must replace Xuanhui with Huizheng.
In Zhiping 18 there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
In Zhizheng 18 there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
s0238 has 至正十八年; 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
In the eighteenth year of Zhiping there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
In the eighteenth year of Zhizheng there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
The same 至正十八年 shows literal Zhiping is wrong; Zhizheng is required.

At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Toqto'a, who did not reply.

At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Taiping, who did not reply.
s0240 has 丞相太平，太平不答; 太平 is Taiping, not 脫脫 Toqto'a.

At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Toqto'a; Toqto'a did not reply.

At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Taiping; Taiping did not reply.
The same 丞相太平，太平不答 shows literal Toqto'a invents a different chancellor; Taiping matches the Chinese.

They again summoned Toqto'a to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Toqto'a only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.

They again summoned Taiping to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Taiping only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.
s0241 has 復召太平至宮…太平依違而已; both mentions are 太平 Taiping, not Toqto'a.

They again summoned Toqto'a to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Toqto'a only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.

They again summoned Taiping to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Taiping only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.
The same 復召太平至宮 and 太平依違而已 confirm literal must read Taiping throughout.
